# Support

Start with the [wiki](https://github.com/MrewyOrg/Botge/wiki), especially
[troubleshooting](https://github.com/MrewyOrg/Botge/wiki/Troubleshooting). Ask questions in
[Discussions](https://github.com/MrewyOrg/Botge/discussions), or report reproducible bugs in
[Issues](https://github.com/MrewyOrg/Botge/issues). Include the relevant command, options, and
sanitized logs. Please use English.
